Maryland, et al. v. United States Department of Agriculture, et al. is a lawsuit brought against the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) and various other United States federal executive departments and their directors. Maryland and eighteen other states sought a temporary injunction in the United States federal government's efforts to fire probationary employees.
Lawsuit
On March 7, 2025, Maryland, Minnesota, the District of Columbia, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Wisconsin.
